report:
MRI of Knee with 
-SG PD FatSat, Locator, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W

* There is a cleft in posterior horn of medial meniscus on coronal F/S T2WI, in favor of radial tear; mild lateral displacement of the body of medial meniscus. 
* There are linear signal intensity from anterior horn to posterior horn of medial meniscus without significant extends into the surface, R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal, may due to myxoid degeneration or contusion.
* Interstitial hyperintensity signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
* High signal in the soft tissue medial to the medial collateral ligament with linear high signal in the ligament, R/O partial tear.
* Wearing of articular cartilage and subchondral bone marrow edema in the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau with osteophytes formation of left knee, reflecting osteoarthritis with bone contusion.
* Large amount of joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. deep infrapatellar bursitis.
* Increased interstitial signal surrounding the pes anserinus on F/S T2WI, in favor of paratendinitis.
* Loculated fluid collection between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst; and with peripheral interstitial hyperintensity, suspect rupture of Baker's cyst.
* Increased interstitial hyperintensity in the tendon and distal muscular fiber of semimembranosus muscle, in favor of tendinosis with grade 1 muscle sprain.
* Subcutaneous edema and intermuscular soft tissue edema of left knee.
> No evidence of tear is noted in lateral meniscus in this study.
> The lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Degenerative enthesitis of patella.
Impression:
1. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus; degeneration of anterior horn of medial meniscus.
2. Osteoarthritis of left knee with synovitis and patellar plicae.
3. Baker's cyst; suspect rupture of Baker's cyst causing perifocal edema and dissecting to medial aspect of proximal leg.
4. Grade 1 injury of MCL and mild MCL bursitis with adjacent soft tissue edema; associated with paratendinitis of pes anserinus tendon.
5. R/O mucoid degeneration of ACL.
6. Subcutaneous edema over left knee to proximal leg.
6. Tendinosis of semimembranosus muscle with  muscle edema.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.
Técnica: RMN de la rodilla. Resultados: Rotura de menisco interno. OA patelofemoral. Derrame. Impresión: Rotura de menisco interno. OA patelofemoral. Derrame.

Posteriyor oblik ve oblik popliteal bağlar ödemli ancak menisküs yırtığı eşlik etmiyor. Posteriyor medyal köşe yapıları bunların dışında korunmuş. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: pain; right knee pain since [DATE]
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Ossified body in the anterior intercondylar notch measuring 0.7 cm. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complete radial tear of the medial meniscus posterior root with severe extrusion. Myxoid degeneration with additional tearing of the posterior horn. Degenerative tearing of the anterior root with small meniscal ossicle. 
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the weightbearing medial femoral condyle and peripheral medial tibial plateau.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Multifocal high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the central medial trochlea without full thickness fissuring along the lateral trochlea. Cartilage heterogeneity and low-grade fissuring along the medial facet. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complete radial tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with degenerative tearing of the posterior horn and anterior root with severe extrusion.
2.	Medial and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Small joint effusion and small Baker's cyst with small intra-articular body in the intercondylar notch. 
4.	Mild patellar tendinosis without tear

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia bilateral. Artritis psorática.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservados. No hay criterios de rotura.
Cartílago de los compartimentos femorotibiales de espesor y señal conservados sin defectos
condrales profundos.
Cartílago rotuliano de espesor conservado con discreta alteración de señal en vértice y faceta
lateral.
Cartílago troclear de espesor y señal conservados.
Engrosamiento y alteración de señal del tendón rotuliano proximal.
Restantes tendones regionales de espesor y señal conservados.
No hay derrame articular. No se observa quiste de Baker.
Leve edema del aspecto superolateral de la grasa de Hoffa.
Trofismo muscular conservado.
Impresión:
Condropatía rotuliana grado 1.
Tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Signos de hiperpresión patelar externa
